name: Stillhour
summary: Sun-warmed therapy and ritual studio site: an inset full-bleed portrait hero with hairline crosshair overlays, condensed Instrument Serif headlines with italic accents, an amber-and-rust palette on cream, a dark 7-column day accordion and arched practitioner portraits.

fonts.pairing: Instrument Serif 400 from 104px down to 32px with tight negative tracking and one italic phrase per headline; Geist 400 to 500 for body, labels and 11px uppercase overlines with a small amber dot

signature: inset 8px full-bleed portrait hero with thin crosshair rules and a small focus box labelling the image
manifesto headline with inline pill-shaped photo and avatar cluster set into the line of type
dark 7-day accordion: one wide open image card plus six narrow columns with vertical serif day names
arched portrait triptych with the centre practitioner larger and ringed by a thin amber circle
imagery: golden-hour close-up portraits with closed eyes, cream peonies and linen, a single warm amber grade across hero, cards and CTA
layout_grid: 1440px canvas, 64px side padding, 140-160px section padding, 3-column card rows with 16-24px gaps, 20-28px card radii, 999px pills and arch masks
